chart.title: Gini coefficient
chart.subtitle: The Gini coefficient measures inequality on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher inequality. Inequality is measured here in terms of income before taxes and benefits.
chart.note: Income is measured before payment of taxes and non-pension benefits, but after the payment of public and private pensions.
